rule: A host version that is not pinned is unsupported for that host only. It does not mark another host or a metric category unsupported.
pass_condition: Both pinned hosts must collect a Skill or Tool call event in this release's real isolated Air smoke. A pinned version alone, parser fixture, historical smoke, failed, unsupported, unknown or pending result is not passing evidence.

completion_gate.statement: The v2.2.0-rc.2 PRD requires both pinned hosts to pass current real isolated Air smoke and all applicable acceptance checks. Any missing or failed required result blocks release. The earlier ADR 0001 section 6 one-host fallback remains historical and cannot release rc.2.
